name: umo-go
description: UMO Go — always-on go-awareness rule, the go-coder agent, and the bundled Go/platform skill set.

interface.shortDescription: go-coder agent and the house Go skill set.
interface.longDescription: Ships an always-apply go-awareness rule, the go-coder implementation agent, and the Go skills UMO services are held to: hexagonal layering on devkit/common, Google Go style, Atlas migrations, devkit clients (NATS, FeatureScript, audit-log, remote config, Sentry, Pyroscope), Dockerfile security and Go-version sync, quality gates, and the go.work workflow for building against unreleased proto-api / devkit checkouts. Skip it when the task is not Go.
defaultPrompt: If this task touches Go, route implementation through agents/go-coder.md and load the matching skill under skills/ before writing code.
Never commit a local-path replace for a platform module — use go.work per skills/go-local-module-dev/SKILL.md.
Run go fmt, golangci-lint, go build and go test (plus the GOWORK=off variants when a go.work is present) before reporting done.
